svg.title: ridgeline: settled work, run without you
svg.desc: ridgeline runs a pipeline of agents. You answer the shaper, which writes shape.md; three specialists draft and a synthesizer merges spec.md; three planners propose and a synthesizer writes numbered phase files. Directions, design, research, and refine are optional stages between them. Each phase is built, checkpointed in git, and reviewed, and a failed review retries it. Below, two tracks of twelve steps compare the two tools: in plumbbob you decide at every step; in ridgeline you decide once, up front. On the line, ridgeline can take plumbbob's hop when the work is settled.
